This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.desc: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Recycled Energy
perks.desc: Reloading after defeating targets grants energy to your lowest charged ability.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.desc: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.desc: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.desc: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Demoralize
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become weakened.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

perks.name: Bray Legacy
perks.desc: Damage with this weapon generates a small amount of ability energy for the one closest to a full charge.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 148 from 5 August 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3S0TObWihybmZdCLM6wIUw?si=cf08fccbb9d44fa7) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for a backup sustained Boss DPS weapon in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Shoreline Dissident is a rapid fire sniper, so the best subfamily for damage output - the frame provides a useful ×0.8 reload animation multiplier when reloading from an empty mag. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are good - Range is 35, but is largely irrelevant, and d2foundry.gg calculates 45 Stability is ×1.0313 flinch resist at base, 70 Handling is 0.32s ready, 0.37s ADS and 0.29s stow speed, and 60 Reload Speed is a 2.69s reload (2.15s when the mag's empty). Ammo Generation is 55, Recoil Direction is 55, and Zoom is 35. With the barrel perk, bump up to recoil control on controller or add Handling for M+KB. Tactical Mag boosts the mag size to 7, but if you don't get that, Appended Mag works to, or look for a reload boosting option. For sustained damage, in the first trait perk column Triple Tap refills one round from reserves after three crit hits - with the max 7 in the magazine that's up to 10 shots without reloading. For damage, depending on your circumstances you could use Precision Instrument boosts damage by up to ×1.25 after six crits, if you're in an elevated position then High Ground also provides ×1.25 damage, or if there are adds that you can kill with an opposite type of weapon or ability energy (that would be darkness - so Stasis or Strand kills) boost damage by ×1.25 for 8.5s. The Bray Legacy Origin Trait is solid in PvE, although less useful on a sniper, generating around 0.2% energy per hit for whichever ability is closest to a full charge. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
